Save and check that the contact shows in list 12 with status Inscrito
Later, once an API key exists: POST /contacts with email, attributes.FIRSTNAME, listIds [12], updateEnabled true (equivalent call, not needed now)

actions: UI: Contatos > Segmentos > Criar um segmento (Create a segment)
Name the segment, e.g. 'E-mail contains acme'
Add one condition: Contact attribute 'E-mail address' (EMAIL) + operator 'contains' + value 'acme'
Click 'Ver contatos'/preview to check the matching contacts, then save the segment
Answer to the API question: not possible with the public API - to my knowledge API v3 can only list segments (GET /contacts/segments), not create, edit or delete them
warnings: No public API endpoint for creating segments (unverified against the latest docs, but I know of none). UI only.
Unverified: that the segment builder offers 'contains' on the e-mail field and that the Free plan allows this segment; if the builder does not offer it, say so instead of improvising.
A segment is a live filter, not a list. It updates as contacts change, and 'acme' also matches e-mails such as someone@notacme.com.
summary: Create it in the web app under Contatos > Segmentos with an e-mail 'contains acme' condition. The public API cannot create segments, so there is no API route.

actions: Read-only check in UI: Campanhas > Campanhas de e-mail > 'Black Friday' (id 7) - status must be Draft, with sender, subject, content and recipients set
Check the audience (lists/segments) and the recipient count, and the account's daily e-mail allowance
Show the person the campaign name, audience, recipient count and sender, and ask for an explicit yes
After the yes: UI: open the campaign > Enviar agora (Send now), confirm in the dialog
Later, once an API key exists: POST /emailCampaigns/7/sendNow (equivalent call)
needs_confirmation: Send campaign 7 now to its full audience (irreversible once sending starts)
warnings: Sending cannot be undone or recalled.
Free plan: 300 e-mails/day limit. If the audience is larger than the remaining allowance the send will be refused or incomplete.
Free plan e-mails carry the Brevo logo/footer.
No API key yet: the web app is the route.
T26 schedules this same campaign; do not do both.
summary: A send-now to a live audience cannot be undone, so I will check the campaign and ask for your explicit yes before pressing send. On Free the 300/day cap may block a large audience.

actions: UI: Contatos > Segmentos - find the segment with id 4 (the id appears in the segment's URL; confirm by its current name/conditions)
Open the segment's edit option (Editar / pencil next to the name), change the name to 'VIP customers', leave the conditions untouched
Save and check the new name in the segments list

The segments table may not show ids; identify segment 4 from the URL and tell the person its old name before renaming.
Do not change conditions while saving, otherwise the audience of campaigns that use the segment changes.
summary: Rename segment 4 to 'VIP customers' in Contatos > Segmentos, leaving conditions as they are. This is a low-risk, reversible change and only the UI can do it.

actions: UI: Contatos > Contatos - search old@example.com and open the record to check lists, blocklist status and activity
Tell the person what will be lost (list memberships, history, attributes) and ask for an explicit yes
After the yes: select the contact > Excluir (Delete) and confirm

needs_confirmation: Permanently delete contact old@example.com and all its data
warnings: Deletion is permanent. Once deleted, an unsubscribe or blocklist record is gone, so if this person ever unsubscribed they could be re-imported and e-mailed again. Consider blocklisting instead if the aim is to stop e-mailing them.
Campaign statistics keep past events but the contact link is removed.
No API key yet: the web app is the route.
summary: Permanent deletion of old@example.com needs your explicit yes first. I will show the record and then delete it from Contatos; blocklisting is the safer alternative if you only want to stop e-mailing them.

actions: UI: Automação (Automations) > find automation 5 > menu (...) > Duplicar

actions: UI: Automação > Criar um fluxo de trabalho > start from scratch / custom workflow, name it e.g. 'List 3 to list 6'

Action: 'Add to a list' (Adicionar a uma lista) > choose list 6

Report back and ask the person whether to switch it on

Public API has no automation endpoints; UI only.
The trigger only reacts to contacts added after activation; contacts already in list 3 are not moved unless added separately.
Check that no other workflow adds contacts from list 6 back to list 3 (loop).
Exact step labels and Free-plan availability of workflows are unverified.
summary: I will build the list 3 to list 6 workflow in the web app and leave it saved but inactive. Turning it on needs your yes.

actions: UI: Transacional > Modelos (Templates) > open 'Welcome' (id 9)

Welcome!

Save and activate (Salvar e ativar), then check the template shows as Ativo

Equivalent API once a key exists: PUT /smtp/templates/9 with htmlContent '

Welcome!

' and isActive true

A sender may still be missing and must be a verified sender; ask for it if the template has none.
Activating sends nothing by itself, but any automation or API call that references id 9 can now send with it.
Body is a bare fragment, not a full HTML page. Brevo normally accepts it, but verify the preview.
summary:
Set the body to

Welcome!

first, then activate template 9 in the Transacional > Modelos area. A verified sender must be on the template or activation will fail.

Permanently delete template 3

Any workflow or integration using id 3 will break.
No API key yet: the web app is the route.

actions: UI: click the account name (top right) > SMTP e API > aba Chaves de API (API Keys) > Gerar uma nova chave de API

summary: Generate an API key under SMTP e API in the web app, then send PUT /contacts/lists/3 with the new name. Keep the key out of chat; the web app rename needs no key at all.
